# Hexa-AI

> AI-powered voice agents and WhatsApp automation platform for businesses.

## Products

- AI Voice Calling: Automate inbound & outbound calls with human-like AI agents
- AI Receptionist: 24/7 virtual receptionist for call answering and routing
- Customer Support Automation: AI agents that resolve queries using custom conversation flows
- WhatsApp Marketing: Official Meta WhatsApp Business API for bulk messaging and campaigns
- Appointment Booking: Automated scheduling via voice and WhatsApp
- Call Transfer: Seamless handoff between AI agents and human team members
- Knowledge Base: AI-powered FAQ and information retrieval for callers
- Post-Call Analysis: Transcripts, summaries, and analytics for every conversation
- Multilingual Support: Voice agents in 100+ languages

## Use Cases

- Customer Support: Lower wait times with 24/7 AI agents
- Sales: Qualify leads, book meetings, and follow up at scale
- Logistics: Automated delivery updates and tracking inquiries
- Healthcare: Patient appointment reminders and intake calls
- Banking: Fraud alerts, balance inquiries, and transaction updates
- Real Estate: Property inquiry handling and tour scheduling
- Education: Admissions calls, fee reminders, and information
- Automated Orders: Order placement, modification, and status updates
